scope: Manifest of the worktrees that were retired because their .git pointers name macOS paths absent from this machine. Records the pointers, the orphaned commit identities, and the check that established what unique payload each tree held. No content is claimed here; the two bundles that hold copied payload are nsc-external-grok-full-interval-uv-20260929 and nsc-external-rho1-source-bound-v2-20260929.
counting_rule: A file counts as unique when its path exists neither in the canonical checkout nor in lab/archive/pre-closure-2026-09-08, after discarding macOS metadata (names beginning ._ and .DS_Store) and version-control internals (.git, .git-nsc, .venv, __pycache__, .pytest_cache).

retired.unique_payload: all 29 are .git-nsc internals; no working file is unique

method: ported from scripts written during the 2026-10-05 sweep; the comparison discarded macOS metadata and version-control internals before counting paths, then searched the canonical history for each remaining path
nonclaim: A path-level comparison. It says nothing about whether two files at different paths hold the same content, and it makes no scientific claim.
